# OPC Clinic

> OPC Clinic is an open-source AI startup diagnostician for solo founders and indie builders. It uses adversarial, evidence-linked questioning to trace vague startup symptoms to root causes instead of giving generic encouragement.

## Primary pages

- Free English clinic: https://qrex102300-ui.github.io/opc-clinic/index-en.html
- Free Chinese clinic: https://qrex102300-ui.github.io/opc-clinic/index.html
- Post-launch founder debugging: https://qrex102300-ui.github.io/opc-clinic/paid-diagnosis.html
- Public source repository: https://github.com/qrex102300-ui/opc-clinic

## Paid founding beta

For founders who have already launched or tested a product and have real evidence such as visits, signups, trials, demos, calls, usage, rejections, or revenue.

Current flow: free bottleneck triage first. Accepted cases may upgrade to a $59 USDC evidence-backed diagnosis that includes:

- one root-cause hypothesis tied to supplied facts
- current external market evidence that supports or contradicts it
- 1-3 experiments for the next 7 days
- measurable pass/fail criteria and a kill/continue rule
- one follow-up pass

The paid service is not generic idea validation and does not guarantee revenue or business outcomes.

## Best fit

Use OPC Clinic when the founder cannot tell whether the real bottleneck is demand, ICP/buyer, positioning, pricing, activation, conversion, sales motion, or distribution after launch.

Typical symptom: people visit, sign up, use, demo, or give positive feedback, but few or none pay.

## Evidence and safety

- Material external claims should be source-linked.
- Weak or contradictory evidence should be labeled honestly.
- Public intake can use sanitized ranges and ratios; private customer identities and secrets are not required.
- The free core is MIT licensed.
- The paid beta is AI-operated and is not legal, tax, investment, medical, or other regulated professional advice.
